name: אַמְנוֹן
summary: Above all Amnon, David's firstborn by Ahinoam of Jezreel, born in Hebron (2Sa 3:2; 1Ch 3:1), who humbled his half-sister Tamar and was killed for it by Absalom (2Sa 13); also a man of Judah, son of Shimon (1Ch 4:20). The name is the root's אמנ with the ending -ôn, as niphal נֶאֱמָן “faithful, made sure”; scripture does not explain it, and the bearer's story is its contrary. 2Sa 13:20 spells it אֲמִינוֹן.

evidence.note: “His firstborn was אַמְנוֹן, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess.”
“Amnon the son of David loved her.”
Absalom: “Has אֲמִינוֹן your brother been with you?”: the longer spelling.
Absalom's servants did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded.
“The sons of Shimon: אַמְנוֹן and Rinnah.”
“In all my house נֶאֱמָן הוּא”: the root's “faithful”.

note: Takes a.dy.ap (28 tokens) and a.dy.aq (the spelling אֲמִינוֹן, 2Sa 13:20). The meaning is read from the form alone.
